catalog.title: Seiko V1
catalog.note: JDM annual (Vol.1). Each caption prints the ref (e.g. QGA010) and list price (円), then the movement code (a four-digit calibre such as 7820, 2220 or A158, or a family code such as 99GQW, 48KQW, 75TPW, 11S, 16NC, 88ST) with jewels (石) where printed and the case material (SS, SGP, HGP, ASGP/APDP/AWGP A-grade plated, PDP palladium, TSGP/TPDP two-tone, SILV silver, TINSB / TI-N NSB titanium, ALM and ALH/SALH/GALH light alloy, GF gold-filled, 14K·YG/WG gold, PC plastic), a crystal/feature line, the case code printed as CCCC<case-dial> (the bracketed part is kept as caseDialCode, the full line in code) and a box with either the bracelet/chain code (X...) or the strap width in mm; on some pages a star is printed before the box. caliber is the printed movement number, or the four-digit prefix of the case code where the movement is printed as a family code; shorter prefixes (11, 16, 43, 88) leave it blank unless a four-digit movement number is printed. No CCCC-NNNN case-movement ref is printed. The feature bullets under each page title (accuracy, battery, water resistance) are summarised in wr. Scan pages 60 and 61 are two copies of the same Silver Wave page. The scan skips printed pages 14, 84, 100 and 125 and repeats printed page 61 (scan pages 60 and 61); the page labels follow the printed numbers. The last scan page (printed 155, Playboy) is not a back cover.
catalog.method: Vision transcription of 250 DPI renders, Oct 2026, every caption verified against 450-600 DPI caption crops of the PDF and every photo box checked on per-page sheets.
